_note: Gentle, practical hints a support person receives. Never say she asked. {name} is replaced with her first name.

talk.label: Ask how I'm really doing
lines: Today could be a nice day to ask {name} how she's really doing, and just listen.
A simple "how are you, really?" to {name} today could mean a lot. No need to fix anything.
Maybe check in with {name} today. Ask an open question and let her lead.

company.label: Some easy company
lines: {name} might enjoy some easy company today. A call, a quiet evening, or just hanging out.
How about some low-key time with {name} today? Nothing planned, just being around.
A cosy, no-pressure evening with {name} could be a lovely idea.

treat.label: A little treat I like
lines: A small treat could brighten {name}'s day. Something she loves, no occasion needed.
Surprising {name} with something small she enjoys could be a sweet gesture today.
Today might be a good day for a little "thought of you" treat for {name}.

walk.label: A walk together
lines: How about inviting {name} for an easy walk today? No agenda, just fresh air together.
A slow walk with {name} could be a nice way to spend a little time together today.
Fancy a stroll? {name} might enjoy an easy walk and a chat.

practical.label: Help with something practical
lines: Could you take one small task off {name}'s plate today? Practical help can mean a lot.
Offering {name} a hand with something everyday, like food, an errand or a chore, could be really kind today.
Today's idea: ask {name} if there's one thing you could handle for her.

space.label: Some space, kindly
lines: {name} might appreciate some calm space today. A kind message without expecting a reply could be perfect.
A gentle "thinking of you, no need to reply" to {name} could be just right today.
Today might be a day to give {name} a little room, with a warm note that you're around.
